TelemetryFramework.description:
The engine that actually executed the work.

Not the engine the caller asked for: production shows
`foundation-models-default` reporting `llamacpp` on 12,422 events because
the requested framework was recorded instead of the selected one.
TelemetryFramework.title: TelemetryFramework

TelemetryPlatform.description:
The OS family the SDK is running on — never the binding.

`react-native` and `flutter` appear as platform values in stored rows; they
are bindings and belong in sdk_binding. They are deliberately absent here so
such events are quarantined and visible rather than silently miscategorised.

get.description:
Get available models for SDK based on authenticated API key and device/platform.

REQUIRES: Valid JWT Bearer token from /auth/sdk/authenticate

The JWT token contains the api_key_id, so we don't need to pass it separately.
This ensures only authenticated SDKs can access model information.

Whether hybrid STT is enabled for the authenticated key, plus usage.

SDKs call this during phase-2 init so the feature can be surfaced (or
hidden) before the first voice interaction instead of failing on it.
